name: insight-vault
description: Local-first research repository: highlight and tag interview quotes, build insights that stay linked to their evidence, and report on support resolutions.
author: Bhuwan Thada

scripts.setup: python -m venv .venv && .venv/Scripts/python -m pip install -r requirements-dev.txt && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
